offering_description.value: Provides insurance claims management, adjusting and related outsourced services to insurers, self-insured employers and corporations. Delivers the work through a global network of claims professionals who investigate, manage and settle claims on the client's behalf.

primary_services.value: claims management; independent claims adjusting; legal settlement administration; risk management consulting; medical cost management

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance carriers, self-insured employers, corporations, brokers and third-party administrator clients

end_markets.value: property and casualty insurance; workers' compensation; healthcare; legal; energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for claims handling, adjusting and management services; project or contract: contracted settlement administration and claims outsourcing programs

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in claims files from insurers and employers and resolves them, sold to insurers and self-insured employers

geography_served.value: global: operates in dozens of countries, with largest presence in North America, the United Kingdom and Europe

specialization.value: niche specialist: claims management and adjusting services, with related legal settlement and risk management services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: dedicated account teams selling to insurers and corporate clients; partners / resellers: brokers and third-party administrators that refer or co-deliver claims work

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: claims adjuster licensing and insurance claims handling rules set by state and national insurance regulators
